Explanation: Sets the layout that arranges the items inside a grouping, a Control or the game window.
A layout that places items left to right, starting a new line when one is full.
A layout that places items in the cells of a grid.
A layout that places each item where its own pixel and percentage values say.
Sets how many columns a container's grid has.
Sets how many rows a container's grid has.
Sets the column and row of a control in a grid. Row 0 is the bottom row.
Makes a control span this many columns.
Gets the LayoutProperties object that the control uses by default.
Chooses how the width is worked out.
Places the control a part of the way across its container. 0.5 is halfway.
Chooses which point of the control is placed at its x position. 0.5 is its center.
Sets a width in pixels that does not change with the window.
Sets the width as a part of the container's width.
Stops the control from getting narrower than this many pixels.
Gives the control another set of properties to choose from.
Makes these properties apply only when the container is at most this many pixels wide.
Adds empty space to the left of a control in a layout.
